Isaiah has $1,201. How much money will Isaiah have left if he buys a case of beakers and a hot plate?
answer:
Isaiah has $1,201. He buys a case of beakers for $268 and a hot plate for $389. The total cost is $268 + $389 = $657. Subtracting this from his initial amount gives $1,201 - $657 = $544.

Thus, Isaiah will have $544 left.
